summary: Completed Phase 2G.5 Stripe webhook + branded email testing. All Stripe webhook flows (invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.deleted) are working correctly with proper notification_log entries. Checkout endpoint accepts expanded payment_method_types. All regression tests passed.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 422 instead of 400 for missing required fields (Pydantic validation)
minor_issues.impact: Minor - FastAPI/Pydantic returns 422 for validation errors, which is standard behavior

passed_tests: POST /api/stripe/checkout - Creates checkout session with expanded payment_method_types (card, link, cashapp, us_bank_account)
POST /api/stripe/webhook (invoice.paid) - Returns 200 and creates notification_log with event_type='stripe_receipt', subject='RoadBoss receipt — $29.99 for RoadBoss Pro', status='queued'
POST /api/stripe/webhook (invoice.payment_failed) - Returns 200 and creates notification_log with event_type='stripe_payment_failed', subject='Payment issue on your RoadBoss subscription'
POST /api/stripe/webhook (customer.subscription.deleted) - Returns 200 and creates notification_log with event_type='stripe_subscription_cancelled', subject='Your RoadBoss subscription is cancelled'
POST /api/stripe/webhook (unknown customer) - Returns 200 even when user lookup fails (no 500s)
GET /api/notifications/logs - Shows stripe_* entries with correct recipient (fleet_admin@highwaypilot.io) and subjects
Login for all 7 demo users (super_admin, fleet_admin, driver, marcus, aaliyah, tyler, rosa)
GET /api/push/config - Returns VAPID public key (no private key exposure)
POST /api/push/test - Sends test push notification with auto-cleanup
GET /api/notifications/status - Shows Twilio and SendGrid configured
POST /api/crash-events - Creates crash event (works with zero push subscriptions)
